description: The >>FLAG-NATIVE-ARITHMETIC directive - the second leg of Annex E.2 item 21, on the identical window as flag-85-directive-window: introduced in COBOL-2002, classified obsolete by the 2014 standard, REMOVED in COBOL-2023. THE EDGES ARE QUOTED from the edition texts (kb/Work PB3965): COBOL-85 has no compiler directives (§1985:IV.6.4.2.2.1: 'The compiler directing verbs are COPY, ENTER, REPLACE, and USE'); §2002:7.2.12 introduces the directive: 'The FLAG-NATIVE-ARITHMETIC directive specifies that when standard arithmetic has been specified or implied for the source unit, any arithmetic operation that uses native arithmetic shall be flagged', and §2002:F.2 item 29 lists among the new compiler directives one 'to request the flagging of syntax that might require native arithmetic when standard arithmetic is in effect'; §2014:7.3.13 keeps it and classifies it: 'NOTE The FLAG-NATIVE-ARITHMETIC directive is an obsolete element in this International Standard and is to be deleted in the next edition of standard COBOL', which fixes obsoleteIn=2014; §2023:E.2 item 21 removes it: 'The following features that were classified as obsolete in the previous COBOL standard, have been removed from this Working Draft International Standard: - FLAG-85 - FLAG-NATIVE-ARITHMETIC - ...', which fixes removedIn=2023. Its operand syntax is the 2002 and 2014 texts' (§2002:7.2.12.1), diagnosed and acted on by FlagDirectiveProcessor + FlagConformancePass (kb/Work PB5600); the row gates the directive WORD by edition. Below 2002 COBOL0900, at 2023 COBOL0902, at 2014 the COBOL0903 obsolete warning. (VCR row 28's third and fourth legs, Standard Arithmetic and MOVE QUOTE, were already rowed.)

directiveOperand.citation: ISO §2002:7.2.12.1 general format (ON or OFF) — a structured operand, diagnosed by its own stage as COBOL1622. The 2023 text carries no clause (Annex E.2 item 21 removed the directive); the 2002 and 2014 texts print the format.

source:
>>FLAG-NATIVE-ARITHMETIC ON
       IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. PB725FN.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
       MAIN.
           DISPLAY "X".
           STOP RUN.

directivePlacement.text: The FLAG-NATIVE-ARITHMETIC directive may be specified only between clauses in divisions other than the procedure division and only between statements in the procedure division
